newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BTA OPV six times oversubscribed - bourse.
newsitem.headline: BTA OPV six times oversubscribed - bourse.

text.p: The public offer to sell (OPV) in the privatisation of a 13.22 percent stake in Portuguese bank Banco Totta e Acores was more than six times oversubscribed, Lisbon bourse said.
The number of shares available in the OPV was raised by 240,000 shares to 1,840,000 and applications were received for 11,738,040 shares, bourse officials said.
BTA employees acquired 635,000 shares and small investors and emigrants acquired a total of 705,000.
These groups acquired the shares at a price of 2,367 escudos, a discount of 10 percent from the fixed price of 2,630 escudos per share available for other investors.
BTA president Alipio Dias said 800,000 BTA shares were placed in the direct national sale and 5,289,471 shares in the international direct sale.
